Based on the screenshot, here is an **extreme pixel-perfect analysis** of the "Browse by Category" section: --- ### **1. Section Background & Container** - **Background Color**: `#FFFFFF` (Pure white) - **Container Max-Width**: `1280px` (standard large container) - **Container Padding**: `0 24px` (24px left/right padding on mobile, likely `0 48px` on desktop) - **Section Padding**: - Top: `80px` (approx) - Bottom: `60px` (approx) --- ### **2. Header Elements** #### **A. Badge/Label ("EXPLORE COURSES")** - **Text**: "EXPLORE COURSES" (uppercase) - **Font Size**: `12px` or `13px` - **Font Weight**: `600` (semibold) - **Color**: `#6366F1` (Indigo-500) - matches primary brand color - **Letter Spacing**: `0.5px` to `1px` - **Icon**: Compass/navigation icon (`fa-compass` or similar), size `14px`, same color - **Container**: - Background: Transparent or very light tint `#EEF2FF` (Indigo-50) - Border: `1px solid #E0E7FF` (Indigo-100) - Border Radius: `9999px` (full pill shape) - Padding: `6px 16px` - Display: Inline-flex, centered horizontally above heading #### **B. Main Heading ("Browse by Category")** - **Text**: "Browse" in dark gray/black, "**Category**" in purple accent - **Font Family**: Inter, SF Pro, or system sans-serif - **Font Size**: `40px` to `44px` (desktop), responsive down to `32px` on mobile - **Font Weight**: `700` to `800` (bold/extrabold) - **Color**: - "Browse by": `#111827` (Gray-900) - "Category": `#7C3AED` (Violet-600) or `#6D28D9` (Purple-700) - **Line Height**: `1.2` - **Alignment**: Center - **Margin Bottom**: `12px` #### **C. Accent Underline Bar** - **Width**: `60px` (fixed width, centered under text) - **Height**: `4px` - **Color**: `#6D28D9` (Purple-700) or gradient from `#6366F1` to `#8B5CF6` - **Border Radius**: `2px` (slightly rounded ends) or `9999px` (pill) - **Position**: Centered below heading, margin-bottom `24px` - **Note**: Positioned specifically under the word "Category" or centered under entire heading #### **D. Subtitle Text** - **Text**: "Explore courses by your interested categories and find the perfect course to start learning" - **Font Size**: `16px` to `18px` - **Font Weight**: `400` (regular) or `500` (medium) - **Color**: `#6B7280` (Gray-500) - **Max Width**: `600px` to `650px` - **Alignment**: Center (margin auto) - **Line Height**: `1.6` or `1.75` - **Margin Bottom**: `48px` to `56px` (generous spacing before grid) --- ### **3. Decorative Dot Patterns** - **Location**: Left and right sides of the header area (background decoration) - **Pattern**: Grid of dots (4x4 or 5x5 matrix) - **Dot Color**: `#E0E7FF` (very light indigo/purple) with low opacity (~30%) - **Dot Size**: `4px` diameter each - **Spacing Between Dots**: `12px` to `16px` - **Position**: Absolute positioned, vertically centered with the heading area, offset ~40px from container edges --- ### **4. Category Cards Grid Layout** - **Columns**: 4 columns on desktop (`grid-cols-4`) - **Gap**: `24px` between cards (both row and column gap) - **Responsive Behavior**: - Desktop (≥1024px): 4 columns - Tablet (768px-1023px): 2 columns or 3 columns - Mobile (<768px): 1 column (stacked) --- ### **5. Individual Category Card Specifications** #### **Card Container** - **Background**: `#FFFFFF` (white) - **Border**: `1px solid #E5E7EB` (Gray-200) or `#F3F4F6` (Gray-100) - **Border Radius**: `16px` or `20px` (large rounded corners) - **Box Shadow**: - Default: `0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)` (subtle) - Hover: `0 10px 25px -5px rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.15)` (purple-tinted shadow lift) - **Padding**: `28px` to `32px` (all sides equal) - **Min Height**: `220px` to `240px` (consistent height across cards) - **Display**: Flex column, space-between for content distribution - **Hover Effect**: - Transform: `translateY(-4px)` or `translateY(-8px)` - Border color change: `#C7D2FE` (lighter purple) - Shadow elevation increase - Transition: `all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` #### **Card Icon (Left Side)** - **Container Shape**: Rounded square or circle - **Dimensions**: `56px × 56px` or `64px × 64px` - **Border Radius**: `16px` (if square) or `50%` (if circle) - appears rounded-square in design - **Background Colors (per category)**: - Development: `#EDE9FE` (Violet-100) - Design: `#ECFDF5` (Emerald-50) or `#F0FDF4` (Green-50) - Marketing: `#FFF7ED` (Orange-50) - AI & Data: `#EFF6FF` (Blue-50) - Business: `#FDF2F8` (Pink-50) - Mobile Dev: `#F5F3FF` (Violet-50) - Cloud: `#F0FDFA` (Teal-50) - Others: `#FAF5FF` (Purple-50) - **Icon**: - Font/Type: Lucide icons or Phosphor icons (outlined style) - Size: `28px` to `32px` - Colors matching category theme: - Development: `#7C3AED` (Purple) - Design: `#059669` (Emerald/Green) - Marketing: `#EA580C` (Orange) - AI & Data: `#2563EB` (Blue) - Business: `#DB2777` (Pink) - Mobile Dev: `#6366F1` (Indigo) - Cloud: `#0891B2` (Cyan) - Others: `#DB2777` (Pink/Magenta) #### **Card Content (Right of Icon)** - **Layout**: Flex row with icon left, content right (on desktop); or icon top, content below (depending on exact layout - image shows icon left, content right) ##### **Title** - **Font Size**: `20px` to `22px` - **Font Weight**: `700` (bold) - **Color**: `#111827` (Gray-900) or `#1F2937` (Gray-800) - **Margin Bottom**: `4px` to `8px` ##### **Course Count** - **Text Format**: "[Number]+ Courses" - **Font Size**: `14px` to `15px` - **Font Weight**: `600` (semibold) - **Colors (per category)**: - Development: `#6D28D9` (Purple-700) - Design: `#047857` (Green-700) - Marketing: `#C2410C` (Orange-700) - AI & Data: `#1D4ED8` (Blue-700) - Business: `#BE185D` (Pink-700) - Mobile Dev: `#4F46E5` (Indigo-600) - Cloud: `#0E7490` (Cyan-700) - Others: `#BE185D` (Pink-700) ##### **Description Text** - **Font Size**: `14px` to `15px` - **Font Weight**: `400` (regular) - **Color**: `#6B7280` (Gray-500) or `#4B5563` (Gray-600) - **Line Height**: `1.5` or `1.6` - **Margin Top**: `12px` - **Max Lines**: 2 lines (with ellipsis if overflow) --- ### **6. Arrow Button (Bottom Right of Card)** - **Shape**: Circle - **Size**: `40px × 40px` or `44px × 44px` - **Background**: Light tint matching category color (e.g., `#F3E8FF` for purple category) - **Border**: None or very subtle `1px solid` transparent - **Icon**: Right arrow (`→`, `fa-arrow-right`, or `arrow-right` from Lucide) - **Icon Size**: `18px` to `20px` - **Icon Color**: Matches the category's primary color (same as course count text) - **Position**: Absolute bottom-right or flex-aligned to bottom-right of card - **Hover Effect**: - Background darkens to solid category color - Icon color changes to white - Slight scale: `scale(1.1)` - Translate: `translateX(2px)` (arrow moves right) --- ### **7. "View All Categories" Button** - **Position**: Centered below grid - **Margin Top**: `48px` to `56px` - **Text**: "View All Categories" - **Font Size**: `16px` - **Font Weight**: `600` (semibold) - **Color**: `#6D28D9` (Purple-700) - **Background**: `#FFFFFF` (white) - **Border**: `1.5px solid #E5E7EB` or `2px solid #DDD6FE` (light purple-gray) - **Border Radius**: `12px` or `9999px` (appears slightly rounded rectangle, not full pill) - **Padding**: `14px 32px` (horizontal generous padding) - **Icon**: Arrow right at end of text, size `16px`, color matching text - **Hover Effects**: - Border color: `#6D28D9` (solid purple) - Background: `#F5F3FF` (very light purple) - Shadow: `0 4px 12px rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.15)` - Transform: `translateY(-2px)` --- ### **8. Responsive Breakpoints Detail** | Breakpoint | Columns | Card Padding | Font Sizes | Gap | |------------|---------|--------------|------------|-----| | **Mobile (<640px)** | 1 col | 20px | Heading: 28px
Subtitle: 15px
Title: 18px | 16px | | **Tablet (640-1024px)** | 2 cols | 24px | Heading: 32-36px
Subtitle: 16px | 20px | | **Desktop (>1024px)** | 4 cols | 28-32px | Heading: 40-44px
Subtitle: 17-18px | 24px | **Mobile Specifics**: - Icon and title stack vertically (icon on top) OR remain side-by-side but smaller - Description text may hide on mobile to save space, or show 2 lines max - Arrow button remains visible --- ### **9. Special Visual Effects & Gradients** - **No heavy gradients** on cards (clean flat design aesthetic) - **Subtle shadow gradients**: Box shadows use RGBA black/purple with blur for depth - **Icon backgrounds**: Solid light tints (10% opacity of main color), not gradients - **Hover states**: Use smooth cubic-bezier transitions (`cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`) - **Active states**: Scale down slightly `scale(0.98)` on click/tap --- ### **10. Typography System Summary** - **Primary Font**: Inter (Google Fonts) or system-ui - **Heading Tracking**: `-0.02em` (tight letter spacing for large headings) - **Body Tracking**: `0` or `0.01em` - **Uppercase Elements**: Badge label uses uppercase with wider tracking `0.05em` This design follows a **modern Bento-grid / Soft UI aesthetic** with consistent 16px/24px/48px spacing rhythm, using a **monochromatic base + single accent color per category** approach for visual hierarchy.
